flashcards.q: How is gantt charts used in Event Management?
flashcards.a: PROJECT LIFECYCLE FRAMEWORK The event project lifecycle comprises five definitive phases: Initiation, Planning, Execution, Monitoring & Control, and Closure. - Initiation: Define event purpose, scope, and feasibility; conduct SWOT analysis; identify key stakeholders. - Planning: Develop the Event Management Plan (EMP) including Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), Gantt charts, and critical path analysis (CPA).
